description: One case per ELEMENT shape a result list can hold, because the layout a list gets is decided from its element's descriptor and nothing else. Scalars, a short record, a twelve-column record, a record carrying prose, a record carrying records that carry lists, and both file kinds. Every pipe runs for real; the image case is a PipeImgGen because the language forbids a PipeLLM resolving to a concept that contains images. The gallery pins an image model explicitly: the deck's default backend refuses more than one image per call (`can't generate multiple images at once`), so a `Image[3]` output needs one that does not.

Outline of a short book on optics, as chapters, each with its sections, each section with the points it makes and the page it starts on.
Chapter 'Light': section 'Waves and rays' on page 3, making the points that light travels in straight lines, that it bends at a boundary, and that both models are useful; section 'Colour' on page 11, making the points that colour is wavelength and that the eye samples it with three receptors.
Chapter 'Lenses': section 'Refraction' on page 21, making the points that a curved surface focuses, that focal length follows curvature, and that glass disperses; section 'Aberration' on page 33, making the points that no single lens is perfect and that combinations cancel errors.
